name: emvistegrast
sort_evidence: Emvistegrast (GS-1427) is Gilead's oral alpha4beta7 integrin inhibitor; Phase 2 NCT06290934 in ulcerative colitis passed primary completion on 2026-03-04 and is active not recruiting, and no readout or discontinuation was found.

trials.title: Study of GS-1427 in Participants With Moderately to Severely Active Ulcerative Colitis
